label: takes precedence over
type: subject = a setting or scope-level value; object = another setting it overrides when the two conflict; means the subject's value wins.
note: Promoted at cross-round recurrence 2 - one occurrence in this round's data batch (a bucket or collection maximum TTL capping a longer per-item expiration) and one earlier. Fills a real gap: the registry could previously state that two settings existed and that one was a default, but not that one silently overrides the other, which is precisely the class of fact that surprises an administrator in production.
